answer: A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Chainbound brooch keeper pearl writ sees to it, since a writ brooch keepers sign after jewel shop audits. The terrace is small, but the toll is 70 stamped dockets, each costing $38 to have checked, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. One haven, one entry. The tally keeps vault.
